name: substance-designer-tutor
description: A collection of artist-led Substance Designer tutors. Currently ships two tutors: the project-anchored fabric pipeline (Anastasia Kukosh / Adobe 'Designer First Steps') and the FX-Map / math-driven approach (Andrei Zelenco). Plus FAQ generation and pysbs/sd.api integration utilities.

contributors.name: Andrei Zelenco
contributors.note: Subject of the sd-fxmap-math-tutor skill. Not a code contributor; the skill curates Andrei's publicly available educational content (YouTube channel @andreizelenco4164, ArtStation, 80.lv articles) with per-paragraph citations. Paid Gumroad content is referral-only, never ingested.
